blocks.text: Marketing systems that lower CAC, grow retention, and scale!

I help startups and scale-ups build the marketing engine they need to grow — connecting acquisition, CRM, retention, analytics, and creative execution into one practical system grounded in real customer data.
Maria Artemieva
Head of CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Building retention into the #1 revenue channel for marketplaces, foodtech and e-commerce
Porto, Portugal → Remote (EU / UK / US East) → maria@cmo.bio → linkedin.com/in/cmo-bio → cmo.bio
Summary

Senior CRM leader with 15 years building retention into the primary revenue channel for marketplaces, foodtech and retail. Grew CRM share of revenue from 11% to 74% in 11 months at KupiVip. Delivered +5% incremental revenue on a mature product at Yandex Eats with a CRM function built from zero. Led teams up to 18 people across strategy, lifecycle, analytics and content. Hands-on with Bloomreach Engagement (Exponea), Mindbox, customer data architecture, A/B testing at scale.
Selected Highlights

🟢 Yandex Eats → built CRM function from 3 to 18 people, delivered +5% incremental revenue on a mature foodtech product within one quarter 🟢 KupiVip → grew CRM share of revenue from 11% to 74% in 11 months, a key driver of the first positive EBITDA in company history 🟢 Regional marketplace (2025) → quadrupled email revenue per delivered message and brought popup checkout rate from 12% to 45% in 8 months with less than 1 FTE on CRM 🟢 Out of Cloud (CRM agency) → acted as Head of CRM for a 30+ client portfolio (Vprok/X5, Haier, JBL, Vita), grew the strategist team from 1 to 10 🟢 Svyaznoy (3,500 stores) → designed the decile analysis methodology now used across all my retail and digital projects → +5% incremental revenue in a 15-store pilot
Experience
CMO, 63pokupki → Regional E-commerce Marketplace
Aug 2025 – Present → Russia-based regional marketplace with a group-buy model and no paid acquisition channel by design → CRM and owned channels are the entire growth engine

CRM channel reform (email + popup, stack: Mindbox). Email reputation low → good in 8 months. Revenue per delivered email 1.8 RUB → 7 RUB (4x). Email channel revenue 1.5M RUB/month → 7.2M RUB/month (5x). Popup cart buyout rate 12% → 45% (3.75x), popup channel revenue 7M RUB → 12M RUB/month. Delivered with less than 1 FTE on CRM (part-time freelancer plus shared marketer time).

Social channels resilience (Telegram + social, ~20% of company revenue at start). Grew channel revenue 1.8x despite Russian platform bans and Telegram throttling → integrated MAX as a parallel platform, automated production workflow, restructured the team, introduced advanced analytics. Team of 4 regional specialists plus one strong lead.
Operating as player-manager across a small marketing org → owned strategy, hands-on execution and team development with no paid budget cover.
Marketing Leadership for International Startups → SaaS / EdTech / iPaaS
Jan 2023 – Present → growth and CRM/lifecycle leadership across startups at different stages of international expansion

Latenode (iPaaS / AI Automation SaaS) → Marketing Advisor, Oct 2024 – Present. Growth and positioning for the shift to higher-ARPU B2B and white-label iPaaS. Delivered ROI calculator, adaptive landing strategy, ad campaigns for non-technical decision-makers.

Seneka (US EdTech, social-emotional learning for parents) → CMO, Jan 2023 – Jan 2025. Rebuilt Web2App funnel → CAC reduced 6x (−83%) in 4 months. Organic content engine 0 → 100K Instagram followers, 70M annual reach with 0.5 FTE → AI-assisted content factory (GPT, Midjourney) built before this stack became standard.

Adapty (subscription SaaS) → General Manager Marketing, Feb 2025 – May 2025. Short-term engagement leading marketing operations during the company's growth phase. Concluded by mutual agreement after scope re-alignment.
Head of CRM, Yandex Eats → Foodtech / Marketplace
Nov 2021 – Jan 2023 → built CRM as a function from scratch in one of the two leaders of the Russian food delivery market

+5% incremental revenue on a mature product within one quarter of starting, measured via control group. Held for a second quarter, then naturally slowed → reported the slowdown honestly to leadership rather than chasing an impossible pace.

Brand affinity matrix across tens of thousands of brands → behavioral scoring layer (offline visit → page view → add-to-cart → purchase → repeat → complaint) that answered "what to offer this user" without waiting for a full ML model. Later accelerated with an ML model built jointly with Yandex's predictive analytics team.

Four-scenario segmentation (everyday restaurants, premium restaurants for corporate, large grocery basket, Lavka express) → reshaped communication schedules and tone per scenario, layered on top of demo / RFM logic.

Team grew from 3 to 18–20 people including outstaff. Infrastructure and methodology stayed with the company; I continued running an internal CRM course for the team for almost a year after my departure.
Head of CRM, Out of Cloud → CRM Agency, 30+ Enterprise Clients
Jun 2020 – Oct 2021 → joined when 2 of 3 strategists had quit from burnout and the third was leaving → effectively acted as Head of CRM for 30+ retail and consumer brands

Owned the full 30+ client portfolio personally (up to 12 client meetings per day) while building the next generation of strategists → designed and ran a 3-month internship program with weekly drop-offs → grew the team from 1 to 10 in 16 months.

Published client outcomes during this period: Vprok.ru (X5) CRM share of revenue 5% → 10% (+200M RUB incremental); email header CTR 10% → 20% on a 10.2% market benchmark. Haier on-site contact capture 0.67% → 1.2% (+$30K/month). Vita Pharmacies CRM launched from zero, KPI doubled in 3 weeks. JBL/Harman 5,000 new subscribers at 2.7x lower CPL than benchmark.
CRM & Marketing Consulting
Jun 2015 – May 2020 → 9 retail engagements and 12 startup engagements across foodtech, fashion, marketplace and SaaS.
CMO, KupiVip → Online Fashion Discounter (flash sales marketplace)
Aug 2014 – Jun 2015 → joined with 48 reports across 5 functional sub-departments, 4 of 5 sub-leads vacant, 18 KPIs from the investor board

CRM share of revenue 11% → 74% in 11 months → built an in-house recommendation engine (72-page algorithm), tied email frequency to daily site conversion, designed "preserves" library for external event triggers, raised send frequency from 5 to 7 per day with no rise in unsubscribes after discovering users perceived emails as service, not spam.
Real audience insight (decile analysis + interviews) → reversed the brand strategy from aspirational-discount to quality-positioning, repositioned all communications and creatives.
All 18 marketing KPIs delivered; first positive EBITDA in company history reported at the second quarterly investor meeting.
CMO of Retail Loyalty Programs, Svyaznoy → Mobile Tech Retail (3,500 stores)
Sep 2010 – Jun 2014 → ran the loyalty function for one of the largest Russian retail chains of its era

Transactions per user 1.2 → 4.1 across the full loyalty period through coalition program rebuild, behavioral segmentation, and a redesigned cross-brand acquisition layer (2,000 unique mechanics in 18 months).

Decile analysis methodology + the "Methylene Blue Method" → discovered the first decile behaves as a leading indicator for future mass-market hits → redesigned the assortment matrix → +5% incremental revenue in a 15+15 store pilot. Methodology has stayed with me as a starting tool across every CRM project since.
CMO, EXPERT Retail → Consumer Electronics (320+ stores)
Dec 2006 – May 2010 → strategic marketing and cross-marketing programs for a national consumer electronics chain.
Marketing Analyst → CMO, MERLION → Computer Retail
Nov 2002 – Nov 2006 → launched the first national computer retail chain in Russia, scaled 0 → 150 stores in 9 months, revenue per sqm $1,000 → $3,000+.
Teaching
CRM Strategy Lecturer, ClientCore Agency → 2024 – Present → lectures for CRM strategists on segmentation, lifecycle architecture, analytical methodology.
Skills & Stack

CRM / CDP platforms → Bloomreach Engagement (Exponea), Mindbox, HubSpot, 40+ platforms across foodtech, retail and SaaS. Analytics & BI → Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, GA4, Metabase. Methods → behavioral segmentation, lifecycle architecture, A/B testing at scale, decile analysis, brand affinity modeling, customer data infrastructure. AI / Automation → ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, n8n, Latenode.
Languages

English → Professional working proficiency (working language across US edtech, international SaaS, international teams)
Russian → Native
Portuguese → Elementary (improving, based in Portugal)
Dutch → Elementary
Education

Reforge → Product, Growth, Retention & Engagement, Social Strategy programs → 2024–2025 Skolkovo Open University → Practicum for Directors (intensive 6-month executive program) → 2016 Plekhanov Russian University of Economics → MA Marketing → 2001 The Hague University of Applied Sciences (TH Rijswijk) → BS Marketing → 2001
